test_title: RRB Group D Official Paper (Held On: 09 Dec, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
This question is based on the five, three-digit numbers given below.

(Left) 783 791 531 563 594 (Right)

(Example- 697 – First digit = 6, second digit = 9 and third digit = 7)

NOTE - All operations to be done from left to right.

What will be the resultant if the second digit of the highest number is added to the second digit of the lowest number?2431
solution:
Given: (Left) 783 791 531 563 594 (Right)**

Highest number = 791

Second digit of the highest number = 9

Lowest number = 531 

Second digit of the lowest number = 3

Now, 9 + 3 = 12

Hence, the correct answer is “Option 3**”.
